description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter (RecipeAdapter) for displaying recipe items in a grid layout on Android TV. It manages view creation, data binding, and focus handling for TV navigation.

classes.name: RecipeAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying recipes with focus and navigation support for Android TV.

classes.name: RecipeViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class managing individual recipe item views.

classes.name: RecipeDiffCallback
classes.description: DiffUtil callback for efficiently updating the list of recipes.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new RecipeViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds recipe data to the ViewHolder.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Recipe object to the item view, setting texts and image, and handling click events.

methods.name: areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two Recipe items are the same based on their IDs.

methods.name: areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if the contents of two Recipe items are the same.
